apps/web/components/features/admin/table.long-content: The component renders three icon buttons and no text content; labels are fixed strings from props that cannot grow. The detector matched the words label and title in aria and title attributes.
apps/web/components/features/admin/table.offline: The component never fetches: it only calls the onRefreshIngest and onToggleVerification callbacks its parent owns, and shows the parent's loading status. Offline handling belongs to the parent row.

apps/web/components/features/dashboard/o.loading: Pending is only entered through the addManualDspMatch server action, which Storybook does not run; the pending label and disabled submit are asserted in AddPlatformDialog.test.tsx by awaiting the action.
apps/web/components/features/dashboard/o.error: The inline error appears only after the addManualDspMatch server action resolves with a failure or throws, which Storybook does not run; both paths are asserted in AddPlatformDialog.test.tsx.
apps/web/components/features/dashboard/o.offline: Offline is the same thrown-action path as error: addManualDspMatch rejects and the dialog shows its fixed could-not-be-added message, asserted in AddPlatformDialog.test.tsx.
apps/web/components/features/dashboard/o.permission-denied: The dialog has no gated action: any signed-in artist can link a platform, and authorization lives in the addManualDspMatch server action. The detector matched role='alert' on the inline error, which is the error state.
